name: Serizawa Hiroko
source:
Hiroko Serizawa is Miki's mother and Shizue's younger sister. She has a beautiful face and a voluptuous body that makes it hard to believe she is a mother of one. She lives a very ordinary family life, but by chance she catches the eye of the protagonist, who is searching for "prey", and both her daughter and sister fall into his clutches.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071023044146/http://www.bpb.jp/products/r2/index.html]the official site[/url]]
